reason: The whiteboard and my notebook have never once failed me on a Tuesday night, and I am the one who knows the bracket anyway. ₹1,500 is not the problem; swapping something that works for something that can go dark mid-frame is the problem.
objection: What happens when the internet drops in the middle of a tournament? Half my regulars are standing there with phones and no bracket, and the match on that screen is the only thing keeping the rest of them seated.
would_change_my_mind: Show me it runs fully offline on my own WiFi or off a phone hotspot, with scoring that keeps working and syncs later, and that the bracket can share the screen with the cricket instead of taking it over.
